rationale: The assistant correctly explained that U means no suitable pan detected, gave the magnet test, and then confirmed the diagnosis once the customer reported the magnet stuck only to the cast-iron casserole. Options of an induction interface disk or new pans are appropriate and not presented as parts to fit. Minor flaws: the assistant said 'Your diagnosis is spot on' when the customer had asked a question, and it overstated 'Your hob is fine' and 'Your saucepan' (singular), but the evidence supports this reasonably. It also did not restate the warranty route in the final turn, though it covered it in the first.
